# PlatformIO third-party projects

This directory contains WT32-SC01-PLUS projects whose primary development environment is PlatformIO.

Each project is kept in its own directory and separates:

- upstream provenance and license information;
- physical validation evidence;
- our independent adaptations or improvements;
- release manifests/artifacts when redistribution is allowed.

## Projects

- [`subcoderhun-smart-desk-companion/`](subcoderhun-smart-desk-companion/) — SubCoderHUN's WT32-SC01 PLUS Smart Desk Companion (clock, weather, online radio, EEPROM, optional SD logging, LVGL/SquareLine Studio).
